name: App Manager — Enterprise System Utility
tagline: High-security enterprise system management tool. Control bloatware, enforce strict password policies, manage hardware restrictions, and govern Android fleets using full Device Owner capabilities.
description:
A high-security enterprise system management tool and device policy utility designed for managing Android hardware fleets, kiosk devices, and corporate security compliance. Built on Android Device Policy Manager (Device Owner API).

Core Capabilities

🏢 Fleet Management

Leverage Device Owner and Admin permissions for deep system integration. Ideal for kiosk devices or employee fleet management.

🚫 Bloatware Freeze

Disable pre-installed system apps without uninstallation. Reclaim RAM and significantly improve battery life on managed devices.

🔐 Policy Engine

Enforce complex password rules, disable hardware (camera/mic/USB), and configure auto-wipe protocols for compromised devices.

📲 QR Provisioning

Streamline deployment with automated QR-based enrollment. Set up dozens of devices with full Device Owner status in minutes.

🚀 Deployment Guide

Step 1: Device Preparation

For full management, the device should be factory reset. During initial setup, use the afw#setup identifier or a specialized QR code.

Step 2: Grant Admin Rights

Launch App Manager and follow prompts to grant Device Administrator status to enable the core policy engine.

Step 3: Configure Policy

Access the dashboard to select which system apps to freeze and which hardware restrictions to enforce (e.g. Disable Camera, Prevent Factory Reset).

Step 4: Deploy & Monitor

Once configured, the device is locked down. Policies can be updated remotely if integrated with an EMM server backend.
